provenance.operatorDescription: Duplicates or reorders the court-register subscriptions.
provenance.operatorRationale: SubscriptionsService.getSubscriptions pushes matches in input order and de-duplicates nothing, so RecipientMapper emits one recipient per match, in order. Duplicate and reversed inputs pin both facts, and `recipients` is an ordered array in the frozen contract.

operatorDetail.why: every court-register subscription now matches the court house, so the register carries N recipients rather than one and the vocabulary gate becomes the only filter left
